answers.rationale: Protein down (log2fc -0.94); CPTAC RNA down with concordant TCGA RNA. Macrophages dominate transcripts. Surface-annotated; cerebellum IHC level 3. DepMap not selective. Protein down plus replication gives loss_biomarker.

Protein down; CPTAC RNA and TCGA RNA both down. RCC has the top transcript share and the purity bound is above 0. Surface call is surface. IHC not measured, no proteome enrichment. DepMap padj 0.56. Loss biomarker.

Protein up; CPTAC and TCGA RNA up. CD8_T share 0.6 exceeds RCC 0.2, so not tumour-intrinsic. Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level 1, no enrichment reported. DepMap not selective. Infiltration signal.

No CPTAC protein record. RNA down, with TCGA RNA and confirmatory protein concordant. CD8_T share exceeds RCC. No surface record. Brain cortex proteome enrichment flagged. DepMap padj 0.40. Not tumour-intrinsic and protein not down, so infiltration_signal.
